abandoned_contraband.name: Abandoned Contraband
abandoned_contraband.description: A small cache of illegal goods left behind: drugs, stolen jewelry, and forbidden texts.

ale_mug.name: Ale Mug
ale_mug.description: A half-empty mug of ale. Still warm.

ale_quart.name: Ale (per quart)
ale_quart.description: A quart of common ale or beer.

amber_beads.name: Amber Prayer Beads
amber_beads.description: Prayer beads carved from amber, used in orcish spiritual rituals.

amulet_waterbreathing.name: Amulet of Waterbreathing
amulet_waterbreathing.description: A magical amulet that allows the wearer to breathe underwater indefinitely.

ancestor_tablets.name: Ancestor Memorial Tablets
ancestor_tablets.description: Stone tablets engraved with the names of honored ancestors. Sacred to the clan. Recovering these would be a great service to surviving dwarves.

ancestral_blessing.name: Ancestral Blessing Token
ancestral_blessing.description: A small iron token blessed by the ancestors. Carrying it grants a sense of courage and protection. (Game effect: +1 to saving throws vs. fear)

ancestral_skull.name: Ancestral Champion Skull
ancestral_skull.description: The skull of a revered Bloodfang ancestor. Sacred and must be protected.

ancestral_weapon_rack.name: Ancestral Weapon Collection
ancestral_weapon_rack.description: A collection of weapons from fallen Bloodfang heroes. Each bears the marks of countless battles.

ancient_amulet.name: Ancient Amulet
ancient_amulet.description: A jade amulet carved with protective symbols. Radiates faint magic. (Game effect: +1 to AC)

ancient_potion.name: Ancient Potion
ancient_potion.description: A clay bottle containing a glowing liquid of unknown origin. The stopper is sealed with wax. Effect unknown—could be beneficial or dangerous.

ancient_scroll.name: Ancient Scroll
ancient_scroll.description: An ancient scroll written in archaic script. Contains religious texts and historical accounts.

ancient_spirits.name: Ancient Dwarven Spirits
ancient_spirits.description: A bottle of spirits aged for over a century. The label indicates it was brewed during the reign of King Thorin III. Extremely valuable to collectors.

ancient_tablets.name: Ancient Stone Tablets
ancient_tablets.description: Heavy stone tablets inscribed with ancient text in a dead language. Predate the cult by centuries. Would be valuable to historians or temples.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.description: A leather backpack with straps and buckles. Can hold up to 400 gp of weight.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.description: A wooden barrel for storing liquids or goods. Holds 40 gallons.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.description: A blanket and sleeping mat rolled together.

betrayal_letter.name: Letter of Betrayal
betrayal_letter.description: A letter from the traitorous dwarf who sold out Ironfast. Written to the duergar, it details guard rotations, supply room locations, and the location of the secret entrance. The signature has been torn off, but the handwriting is distinctly dwarven.

binding_chains.name: Demon Binding Chains
binding_chains.description: Enchanted chains inscribed with binding runes, designed to restrain demonic entities.

blackmail_letters.name: Blackmail Letters
blackmail_letters.description: Letters containing blackmail material on town officials and wealthy merchants. Silas had insurance against betrayal.

blood_chalk.name: Blood Chalk
blood_chalk.description: Red chalk made from dried blood, used to draw ritual circles.

bloodfang_history.name: Bloodfang Clan Chronicle
bloodfang_history.description: A leather-bound tome detailing 200 years of Bloodfang Clan history. Includes raids, treaties, and ancestral legends.

bloodstained_journal.name: Bloodstained Journal
bloodstained_journal.description: A journal documenting sacrificial rituals. The pages are stained with blood and filled with disturbing details about the cult's victims.

boat_manifest.name: Boat Manifest
boat_manifest.description: Shipping records for goods arriving via the underground river. Shows connections to multiple cities.

bolts.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
bolts.description: A quiver of 20 iron-tipped crossbow bolts.

boots.name: Boots
boots.description: A sturdy pair of leather boots.

boots_levitation.name: Boots of Levitation
boots_levitation.description: Enchanted boots that allow the wearer to levitate at will, rising or descending up to 20 feet per round.

boots_riding.name: Boots, Riding
boots_riding.description: High leather boots designed for riding.

bottle_glass.name: Bottle, Glass
bottle_glass.description: A glass bottle with a cork stopper.

bribe_receipts.name: Bribe Receipts
bribe_receipts.description: Receipts showing bribes paid to town guards, customs officials, and even the harbor master. Names every corrupt official.

broken_beam.name: Broken Support Beam
broken_beam.description: A heavy wooden beam that's cracked and splintered. Evidence of structural failure.

broken_holy_relic.name: Broken Holy Relic
broken_holy_relic.description: The shattered remains of a sacred dwarven relic - a hammer blessed by the god Moradin. Desecrated and broken by the duergar. A cleric might be able to reconsecrate it.

broken_spear.name: Broken Orcish Spear
broken_spear.description: A spear broken in battle. Symbol of the fierce fighting that took place here.

burial_mask.name: Ancient Burial Mask
burial_mask.description: A bronze funeral mask from an ancient priest. Solemn and beautiful, despite the tarnish of centuries.

cage_keys.name: Iron Cage Keys
cage_keys.description: A ring of heavy iron keys for the slave pen cages. Could free any surviving prisoners.

candle.name: Candle
candle.description: A wax candle. Burns for 1 hour. Provides dim light.

cargo_hook.name: Cargo Hook
cargo_hook.description: A large metal hook used for moving heavy cargo. Could be used as an improvised weapon in desperation.

cart.name: Cart
cart.description: A two-wheeled cart. Requires horse or mule to pull. Can carry up to 4000 gp weight.

cart_wheel.name: Cart Wheel
cart_wheel.description: A heavy wooden wheel from a smuggler's cart.

cell_key.name: Prison Cell Key
cell_key.description: An iron key that opens the prison cells where the captives are held.

ceremonial_axe.name: Ceremonial War Axe
ceremonial_axe.description: An ornate dwarven war axe with gold inlay and runes of honor. Too valuable and symbolic to be a practical weapon, but could function as one in a pinch.

ceremonial_bowl.name: Ceremonial Bowl
ceremonial_bowl.description: A stone bowl used in serpent cult rituals. Carved with serpent imagery and stained with old offerings.

ceremonial_dagger.name: Ceremonial Serpent Dagger
ceremonial_dagger.description: An ornate dagger with a serpent-shaped hilt. Used in cult blood rituals, but functions as a weapon.

chain_10ft.name: Chain, 10 feet
chain_10ft.description: 10 feet of iron chain. Stronger than rope.

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.description: A piece of chalk for marking walls and doors.

charred_bones.name: Charred Bones
charred_bones.description: Bones burned by intense heat. Grim reminder of those who fell to the cult.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: A wooden chest with iron bands and a lock.

clan_banner.name: Ironfast Clan Banner
clan_banner.description: The torn and bloodied banner of Clan Ironfast. Bears their proud symbol - a hammer striking an anvil with sparks flying. Recovering this would mean much to any surviving members of the clan.

clan_battle_standard.name: Bloodfang Battle Standard
clan_battle_standard.description: The clan's battle standard—a massive banner depicting a snarling wolf wreathed in flames.

clan_history.name: Clan Ironfast Chronicle
clan_history.description: A massive tome recording the history of Clan Ironfast from its founding 800 years ago. Chronicles wars, alliances, great works, and the lineage of every clan leader.

clan_signet.name: Chieftain's Signet Ring
clan_signet.description: The chieftain's signet ring, symbol of clan authority. Urgot asks you to recover it from the vault.

clothing_common.name: Clothing, Common
clothing_common.description: A set of common clothes (tunic, breeches, simple shoes).

clothing_fine.name: Clothing, Fine
clothing_fine.description: A set of fine clothes suitable for nobility.

cold_coal.name: Cold Forge Coal
cold_coal.description: Coal from the forges, long since gone cold. Evidence of how long the fortress has been occupied.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.description: Copper ore with a distinctive reddish tint. Used in bronze-making.

corrupted_crystal.name: Corrupted Crystal
corrupted_crystal.description: A crystal infused with demonic energy. Radiates corruption and malevolence.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: An iron bar for prying open doors or containers. +2 bonus to force doors.

crushed_crate.name: Crushed Crate
crushed_crate.description: A crate smashed by falling rubble. Whatever was inside is destroyed.

cult_documents.name: Cult Documents
cult_documents.description: A collection of letters, maps, and documents detailing the cult's structure, goals, and connections to larger conspiracy.

cult_journal.name: Cult Journal
cult_journal.description: A journal kept by a cult member documenting their activities and the temple's operations.

cult_orders.name: Serpent Eye Cult Orders
cult_orders.description: Orders from the Serpent Eye cult to the duergar. Commands: 'Secure the deep passage,' 'Convert or eliminate all dwarves,' and 'Prepare the altar for the awakening ritual.'

cult_scripture.name: Cult Scripture
cult_scripture.description: Religious texts of the Serpent Eye cult, describing their beliefs about 'the awakening' and the power of the Serpent.

cult_serpent_banner.name: Serpent Cult Banner
cult_serpent_banner.description: A cult banner depicting a coiled serpent. Hated symbol of the enemy.

cult_supply_manifest.name: Cult Supply Manifest
cult_supply_manifest.description: A manifest of cult supplies and reinforcements. Reveals the extent of their occupation force.

cultist_personal_effects.name: Cultist Personal Effects
cultist_personal_effects.description: Personal belongings of cultists: letters from home, small tokens, basic supplies. Humanizing but sad.

cultist_robes.name: Serpent Eye Robes
cultist_robes.description: Dark hooded robes worn by cult members. Embroidered with serpent symbols. Could be used as a disguise.

cultist_roster.name: Cultist Roster
cultist_roster.description: A list of cult members' names and ranks. Many names are recognizable as Oakhaven citizens.

dark_grimoire.name: Dark Grimoire
dark_grimoire.description: A leather-bound book of dark rituals. Reading it reveals how to create cursed items, but at great risk to one's soul.

dark_relics.name: Dark Serpent Relics
dark_relics.description: Unholy artifacts used in serpent worship: obsidian serpent figurines, blood chalices, cursed amulets. Radiates malevolence. Should probably be destroyed.

demonic_grimoire.name: Demonic Grimoire
demonic_grimoire.description: A tome bound in what appears to be demon skin. Contains instructions for summoning and binding demons. Extremely dangerous.

demonic_tome.name: Demonic Tome
demonic_tome.description: An ancient tome detailing the hierarchy of demons and how to bargain with them. Reading it is perilous.

disguised_crate.name: Disguised Crate
disguised_crate.description: A crate labeled 'Textiles' that actually contains cursed amulets. Classic smuggling technique.

dropped_coin_pouch.name: Dropped Coin Pouch
dropped_coin_pouch.description: A leather pouch dropped by Silas in his flight. Contains 15 gold pieces.

drowned_corpse_loot.name: Drowned Victim's Belongings
drowned_corpse_loot.description: Personal effects recovered from a drowned corpse: a few coins, a soggy pouch, a corroded dagger. A grim reminder of the dangers.

duergar_orders.name: Duergar Military Orders
duergar_orders.description: Official orders to the duergar garrison. Commands them to 'maintain control of the fortress,' 'extract information from prisoners,' and 'hold the passage for the coming darkness.'

duergar_supplies.name: Duergar Military Supplies
duergar_supplies.description: A crate of duergar supplies: rations (mostly dried mushrooms and cave fish), oil, rope, and other gear. All of dark make.

dwarven_artifacts.name: Ancient Dwarven Artifacts
dwarven_artifacts.description: Historical artifacts from Ironfast's founding: ancient weapons, crown jewels, and ceremonial objects. Priceless to dwarven culture.

dwarven_battle_standard.name: Ironfast Battle Standard
dwarven_battle_standard.description: The battle standard carried into war by Ironfast's warriors. Torn and bloodied but still bearing the proud clan symbol. Recovering this would restore hope to the clan's survivors.

dwarven_casualty_list.name: Dwarven Casualty List
dwarven_casualty_list.description: A grim list of fallen defenders, hastily scrawled in the last hours of the battle. Over two hundred names. Some entries note 'taken alive' - prisoners dragged to the slave pens below.

dwarven_prayer_book.name: Dwarven Prayer Book
dwarven_prayer_book.description: A book of prayers to Moradin, the dwarven god of creation and smithing. Written in Dwarvish with beautiful illuminated pages.

eighth_key.name: Eighth Key of the Serpent
eighth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 8.

emerald_eyes.name: Emerald Serpent Eyes
emerald_eyes.description: Two large emeralds carved to resemble serpent eyes, taken from a cult statue. Extremely valuable.

emergency_cache.name: Emergency Supply Cache
emergency_cache.description: A hidden stash containing emergency supplies: coin pouches, gemstones, healing potions, and a scroll of divine protection. The dwarves prepared for siege.

emergency_gold.name: Emergency Gold Stash
emergency_gold.description: A hidden pouch containing 150 gold pieces for emergencies.

enchanted_bracers.name: Bracers of Defense
enchanted_bracers.description: Silver bracers engraved with protective runes. (Game effect: +1 to AC)

enchanted_stone.name: Enchanted Stone
enchanted_stone.description: A smooth stone that glows faintly with magical energy. Purpose unknown, but clearly valuable.

escape_supplies.name: Emergency Escape Supplies
escape_supplies.description: A cache of emergency supplies: rations, water, rope, lockpicks, and a disguise. Silas's insurance policy.

false_manifest.name: False Shipping Manifest
false_manifest.description: A forged manifest listing innocent goods while hiding the real cursed cargo.

feast_plate.name: Silver Feast Plate
feast_plate.description: An ornate silver serving platter from the great hall's feasts. Bears the clan symbol and could fetch a good price.

fifth_key.name: Fifth Key of the Serpent
fifth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 5.

fire_opal.name: Fire Opal
fire_opal.description: A shimmering opal with dancing flames visible within its depths.

fire_resistance_potion.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
fire_resistance_potion.description: A red potion that grants resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.

fire_resistant_cloak.name: Fire-Resistant Cloak
fire_resistant_cloak.description: A heavy cloak treated with fireproofing alchemy. Provides some protection against heat and flames.

first_key.name: First Key of the Serpent
first_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 1.

fishing_net_25ft.name: Fishing Net, 25 sq. ft.
fishing_net_25ft.description: A fishing net, 5 feet by 5 feet.

forge_hammer.name: Masterwork Forge Hammer
forge_hammer.description: A perfectly balanced forge hammer. Bloodfang smiths create legendary weapons with tools like this.

forge_tools.name: Master Forge Tools
forge_tools.description: A complete set of dwarven smithing tools: hammers, tongs, chisels, and files. Of exceptional quality. A smith would treasure these.

fortress_blueprints.name: Fortress Architectural Plans
fortress_blueprints.description: Detailed blueprints of the Scorched Fortress. Shows secret passages, the volcanic vents, and vault location.

fourth_key.name: The Fourth Key
fourth_key.description: The Fourth Serpent Key—a blackened iron key still hot from volcanic energies. Malakar died trying to claim it.

garlic.name: Garlic (bunch)
garlic.description: A bunch of garlic. Repels vampires.

gems_500.name: Precious Gemstones
gems_500.description: A collection of valuable gemstones: rubies, sapphires, and emeralds. Worth approximately 500 gold pieces to a buyer.

genealogy_scroll.name: Genealogy Scroll
genealogy_scroll.description: Records of ancient priest families who served the temple. Some family lines may still exist in the region.

gold_1000.name: 1000 Gold Pieces
gold_1000.description: A heavy pouch containing 1000 gold pieces.

gold_chalice.name: Gold Chalice
gold_chalice.description: An ornate gold chalice used in cult rituals. Bears serpent engravings.

gold_coins.name: Gold Coins
gold_coins.description: A pile of gold coins. Value varies.

gold_torc.name: Gold Torc of Leadership
gold_torc.description: A heavy gold neck torc worn by clan chieftains. Engraved with runes of power.

grappling_hook.name: Grappling Hook
grappling_hook.description: An iron hook with multiple prongs for securing ropes.

grathak_journal.name: Grathak's Personal Journal
grathak_journal.description: The journal of Grathak the Soulless, duergar warlord. Reveals his orders came from 'the Serpent Eye cult in the surface world' and that he was promised 'the fortress and all its wealth' in exchange for securing the deep tunnels for cult use.

grave_offerings.name: Grave Offerings
grave_offerings.description: Items left in graves: small statues, jewelry, coins. Valuable but grave-robbing feels wrong.

greater_healing_potion.name: Potion of Greater Healing
greater_healing_potion.description: A potent healing potion. Restores 4d4+4 hit points.

guard_roster.name: Guard Roster
guard_roster.description: Patrol schedules and duty assignments for cult guards

guard_schedule.name: Guard Rotation Schedule
guard_schedule.description: A parchment detailing the cultist guard rotations and patrol routes throughout the sewers.

guard_schedules.name: Guard Rotation Schedules
guard_schedules.description: Schedules showing when guards patrol the warehouse. Knowledge is power.

guardian_fragment.name: Guardian Stone Fragment
guardian_fragment.description: A fragment of enchanted stone from a destroyed guardian. Still radiates faint protective magic.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.description: A small hammer for driving spikes and pitons.

healers_kit.name: Healer's Kit
healers_kit.description: Bandages, herbs, and medical tools. Grants +2 bonus to healing checks.

healing_potion.name: Potion of Healing
healing_potion.description: A red liquid in a glass vial. Drinking this potion heals 2d4+2 hit points.

heat_resistant_gloves.name: Heat-Resistant Gloves
heat_resistant_gloves.description: Thick leather gloves treated with special oils to resist heat. Essential for forge work.

heroism_potion.name: Potion of Heroism
heroism_potion.description: Grants temporary hit points and +2 to attack rolls for 1 hour. Favored by Bloodfang warriors.

hidden_contraband.name: Hidden Contraband
hidden_contraband.description: Illegal goods hidden inside mundane merchandise: stolen weapons, banned substances, and forged documents.

hidden_gold_75.name: 75 Gold Pieces (Hidden)
hidden_gold_75.description: A hidden stash of 75 gold pieces discovered through careful searching.

hold_map.name: Ironfast Hold Map
hold_map.description: A detailed architectural map of Ironfast Hold showing all levels, passages, and defensive positions. Marked with red X's by the duergar showing their infiltration routes and control points.

holy_symbol.name: Holy Symbol
holy_symbol.description: A wooden holy symbol blessed by a temple priest. Required for clerics to turn undead and cast some divine spells.

holy_symbol_silver.name: Holy Symbol, Silver
holy_symbol_silver.description: A silver holy symbol. Required for clerics to turn undead.

holy_symbol_wood.name: Holy Symbol, Wooden
holy_symbol_wood.description: A wooden holy symbol. Required for clerics to turn undead.

holy_water.name: Holy Water, Vial
holy_water.description: A vial of blessed water. Deals 2d4 damage to undead when thrown.

horn_signal.name: Signal Horn
horn_signal.description: A horn for signaling. Can be heard up to 1 mile away.

horse_riding.name: Horse, Riding
horse_riding.description: A standard riding horse. Movement 24", can carry up to 3000 gp weight.

horse_war.name: Horse, War (Heavy)
horse_war.description: A heavy warhorse trained for combat. Movement 18", can carry up to 4000 gp weight.

incense.name: Ritual Incense
incense.description: Strange-smelling incense used in cult rituals. Burns with an acrid, green smoke.

incriminating_ledger.name: Incriminating Ledger
incriminating_ledger.description: A ledger recording every illegal transaction, bribe, and shipment. This alone could convict Silas.

ink_vial.name: Ink, Vial
ink_vial.description: A vial of black ink for writing.

interrogation_notes.name: Interrogation Records
interrogation_notes.description: Cruel records of prisoner interrogations. Lists what information each dwarf revealed under torture. Most entries end with 'sent to pens' or 'sent to altar.'

invasion_report.name: Cult Invasion Report
invasion_report.description: A detailed report of the cult's assault on the fortress. Lists casualties, breach points, and mentions General Malakar by name.

iron_chains.name: Iron Chains
iron_chains.description: Heavy iron chains used to restrain prisoners.

iron_ingots.name: Iron Ingots
iron_ingots.description: Refined iron ingots ready for forging. High quality orcish iron.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.description: Chunks of iron ore ready for smelting. Common but useful.

iron_spikes.name: Iron Spikes (12)
iron_spikes.description: A dozen iron spikes for securing ropes or wedging doors.

ironfast_ale.name: Ironfast Dark Ale
ironfast_ale.description: A bottle of the fortress's signature dark ale. Strong, bitter, and excellent. Dwarves would pay well for authentic Ironfast brew.

jade_serpent_idol.name: Jade Serpent Idol
jade_serpent_idol.description: A large idol carved from a single piece of jade. Depicts a coiled serpent with ruby eyes. Incredibly valuable.

jade_statue.name: Jade Statue
jade_statue.description: A small statue carved from jade. Depicts a serpent coiled around an altar.

jade_wolf.name: Jade Wolf Figurine
jade_wolf.description: A wolf carved from green jade, eyes set with tiny rubies. A clan symbol.

korvash_correspondence.name: Korvash's Correspondence
korvash_correspondence.description: Letters between High Priest Korvash and other cult leaders. Discusses the key locations, the ritual timeline, and mentions 'The Sanctum' in the eastern wastes.

kranes_journal.name: Krane's Journal
kranes_journal.description: The personal journal of Valerius Krane, detailing his dark plans and the cult's hierarchy.

lantern_bullseye.name: Lantern, Bullseye
lantern_bullseye.description: A directional lantern with focused beam. Burns for 4 hours per flask of oil.

lantern_hooded.name: Lantern, Hooded
lantern_hooded.description: An oil-burning lantern with a hood. Burns for 4 hours per flask of oil.

lava_stone.name: Cooled Lava Stone
lava_stone.description: A chunk of hardened lava. Porous and lightweight despite its size. Can be carved or used as building material.

legendary_deeds_scroll.name: Scroll of Legendary Deeds
legendary_deeds_scroll.description: A scroll commemorating the greatest heroes of Clan Ironfast. Reading it fills you with determination and respect for those who came before.

legendary_weapon_choice.name: Legendary Weapon of Your Choice
legendary_weapon_choice.description: A legendary weapon forged to slay the Serpent Eye. Choose: Longsword, Greatsword, Warhammer, or Battleaxe. +3 weapon. Deals double damage to chaotic evil creatures. The ultimate reward.

lock_good.name: Lock, Good
lock_good.description: A high-quality lock with key. Difficult to pick (-10% to thief skill).

lock_poor.name: Lock, Poor
lock_poor.description: A simple lock with key. Easy to pick (+10% to thief skill).

malakar_battle_plans.name: Malakar's Battle Plans
malakar_battle_plans.description: General Malakar's plans for the Scorched Fortress. Reveals the cult's strategy to awaken the dormant volcano beneath.

manacles.name: Manacles
manacles.description: Iron shackles with a lock. Used to restrain prisoners.

master_ledger.name: Master Ledger
master_ledger.description: The master ledger containing every transaction of Silas's smuggling empire. Names, dates, amounts, and destinations.

masterwork_tools.name: Masterwork Smith's Tools
masterwork_tools.description: Precision tools used for creating masterwork weapons and armor. These alone could teach a human smith techniques lost for centuries.

merchant_ledger.name: The Merchant's Ledger
merchant_ledger.description: A ledger tracking shipments from 'The Merchant' (Silas) to the cult. Records weapons, supplies, and ritual components.

merchant_letters.name: Letters from The Merchant
merchant_letters.description: Correspondence between the cult leader and 'The Merchant.' Discusses 'the awakening,' gathering sacrifices, and 'the ten keys.'

merchant_seal.name: Merchant Seal
merchant_seal.description: An ornate wax seal used by merchants to authenticate official documents.

mining_cart.name: Mining Cart
mining_cart.description: A sturdy wooden cart with iron wheels, used for transporting ore. Too heavy to take, but interesting.

mining_pick.name: Mining Pick
mining_pick.description: A heavy iron pick for mining and digging through stone.

mining_tools.name: Dwarven Mining Tools
mining_tools.description: Picks, hammers, chisels, and other tools for mining. Of dwarven make and quality.

mirror_small.name: Mirror, Small Steel
mirror_small.description: A small polished steel mirror. Useful for seeing around corners or detecting certain monsters.

mithril_ingot.name: Mithril Ingot
mithril_ingot.description: A bar of pure mithril - the legendary dwarven silver-steel. Lighter than steel but harder than dragon scales. Extraordinarily valuable.

moldy_rope.name: Moldy Rope
moldy_rope.description: Rope that's been exposed to moisture. Weak and unreliable.

mule.name: Mule
mule.description: A pack mule. Movement 12", can carry up to 2000 gp weight.

mysterious_key.name: Mysterious Serpent Key
mysterious_key.description: An unusual key found in the hidden shrine. Its purpose is unclear, but it bears the serpent symbol.

ninth_key.name: Ninth Key of the Serpent
ninth_key.description: An ornate key bearing the serpent symbol, obtained from completing Episode 9.

obsidian_blade.name: Obsidian Ceremonial Blade
obsidian_blade.description: A blade carved from volcanic glass, used in orcish coming-of-age rituals. Razor-sharp and beautifully crafted.

officer_insignia.name: Officer's Insignia
officer_insignia.description: A silver badge bearing the hammer-and-anvil symbol of Ironfast's officer corps. Could be sold or returned to surviving dwarves as a token of respect.

oil_flask.name: Oil, Flask (1 pint)
oil_flask.description: A flask of lamp oil. Burns for 4 hours in a lantern. Can be used as a weapon (thrown, 1d8 fire damage if lit).

orc_holy_symbol.name: Bloodfang Holy Symbol
orc_holy_symbol.description: A crude iron wolf symbol sacred to the Bloodfang. Desecrated by the cultists.

orc_prison_log.name: Prisoner Registry
orc_prison_log.description: A log of captured orcs. Many names are crossed out with 'sacrificed' noted beside them.

orcish_rations.name: Orcish Rations
orcish_rations.description: Dried meat, hard bread, and spicy peppers. Sustains an orc warrior for days.

ore_manifest.name: Ore Storage Manifest
ore_manifest.description: A detailed inventory of ore stockpiles. Shows Ironfast was mining mithril, adamantine, and other rare metals before the attack.

packing_materials.name: Packing Materials
packing_materials.description: Straw, cloth, and wrapping materials for packing fragile goods.

parchment.name: Parchment (per sheet)
parchment.description: A sheet of parchment for writing.

pay_records.name: Pay Records
pay_records.description: Financial records showing payments to guards, smugglers, and corrupt officials.

phosphorescent_fungus.name: Phosphorescent Fungus
phosphorescent_fungus.description: A clump of glowing blue-green fungus from the Underdark. Provides dim light for several hours and is used in alchemical preparations.

piton.name: Iron Spike/Piton
piton.description: An iron spike for securing ropes or wedging doors.

platinum_coins.name: Platinum Coins
platinum_coins.description: A pouch of 20 platinum coins from various kingdoms—spoils of successful raids.

platinum_ring.name: Platinum Clan Ring
platinum_ring.description: A platinum ring bearing the seal of Clan Ironfast. Likely belonged to a high-ranking member. Extremely valuable.

playing_cards.name: Playing Cards
playing_cards.description: A worn deck of playing cards left on a table mid-game.

pole_10ft.name: Pole, 10 feet
pole_10ft.description: A 10-foot wooden pole. Useful for probing for traps or testing floors.

pony.name: Pony
pony.description: A small pony. Movement 12", can carry up to 2000 gp weight.

potion_greater_healing.name: Potion of Greater Healing

resistance_charm_cold.name: Charm of Cold Resistance
resistance_charm_cold.description: A small charm that protects against extreme cold. Reduces cold damage by 50% for 1 hour.

scroll_protection_elementals.name: Scroll of Protection from Elementals
scroll_protection_elementals.description: Creates a barrier that elementals cannot cross for 10 minutes. One use.

journal_pyromancer_transformation.name: Pyromancer's Transformation Journal
journal_pyromancer_transformation.description: A cultist's diary detailing the painful process of transforming into living flame. 'Day 14: My skin burns. Day 30: I no longer feel pain. Day 50: I no longer feel anything but fire.'

potion_fire_resistance.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
potion_fire_resistance.description: Grants immunity to fire damage for 1 turn (10 minutes).

flameblade_unfinished.name: Unfinished Flameblade
flameblade_unfinished.description: A sword still being forged in the elemental forge. The blade is half-molten, useless as a weapon but valuable to collectors.

fire_elemental_gem.name: Fire Elemental Gem
fire_elemental_gem.description: A ruby that pulses with inner flame. Warm to the touch. Worth a fortune to mages.

forge_notes.name: Elemental Forge Notes
forge_notes.description: Instructions for crafting weapons infused with elemental power. The cult planned to arm an entire army.

fire_keystone_shard.name: Fire Keystone Shard
fire_keystone_shard.description: A fragment of the destroyed Fire Keystone. It still radiates heat. Evidence that one of the four anchors is broken.

staff_flame.name: Staff of Flame
staff_flame.description: A staff that can cast Burning Hands 3 times per day. The Pyromancer's personal weapon.

robe_firewalking.name: Robe of Firewalking
robe_firewalking.description: Robes that grant immunity to fire damage. AC bonus: +1. The Pyromancer wore these before he became flame itself.

journal_hydromancer_rituals.name: Hydromancer's Ritual Book
journal_hydromancer_rituals.description: Water-stained pages detail rituals to merge with water elementals. 'Breathe the ocean. Become the ocean. The Prince's waters will drown the world.'

pearl_giant.name: Giant Pearl
pearl_giant.description: A pearl the size of a fist, perfectly smooth and luminous. Worth a king's ransom.

potion_water_breathing.name: Potion of Water Breathing
potion_water_breathing.description: A blue-green potion that allows breathing underwater. Duration: 1 hour + 1-10 rounds per dose. 75% chance of 2 doses, 25% chance of 4 doses.

coral_branch_magical.name: Magical Coral Branch
coral_branch_magical.description: A branch of living coral that glows softly in darkness. Valuable to underwater dwellers.

trident_waves.name: Trident of the Waves
trident_waves.description: A trident that returns when thrown and deals +2 damage underwater. The Hydromancer's weapon.

shell_whispering.name: Whispering Shell
shell_whispering.description: A conch shell that, when held to the ear, whispers secrets of the deep. Can answer one question per day.

water_keystone_shard.name: Water Keystone Shard
water_keystone_shard.description: A fragment of the destroyed Water Keystone. Water droplets bead on its surface endlessly.

cloak_waterbreathing.name: Cloak of Water breathing
cloak_waterbreathing.description: A cloak that allows the wearer to breathe underwater indefinitely. AC bonus: +1.

journal_geomancer_meditations.name: Geomancer's Meditations
journal_geomancer_meditations.description: Stone tablets carved with the Geomancer's thoughts. 'To become stone is to become eternal. Flesh decays. Stone endures.'

gem_earth_elemental.name: Earth Elemental Gem
gem_earth_elemental.description: A topaz that seems to contain moving grains of sand. Highly valued by geomancers.

stone_gravity_anchor.name: Gravity Anchor Stone
stone_gravity_anchor.description: A stone that, when held, prevents the bearer from being moved by external forces. Useful in the Elemental Chaos.

crystal_prism_large.name: Large Crystal Prism
crystal_prism_large.description: A massive prism that refracts light into impossible colors. Mages would pay dearly for this.

hammer_earthshatter.name: Earthshatter Hammer
hammer_earthshatter.description: A warhammer that deals +2 damage and shatters stone on a natural 20. The Geomancer's weapon.

gem_diamond_huge.name: Huge Diamond
gem_diamond_huge.description: A flawless diamond the size of a hen's egg. One of the most valuable gems in existence.

earth_keystone_shard.name: Earth Keystone Shard
earth_keystone_shard.description: A fragment of the destroyed Earth Keystone. Heavy as lead, hard as diamond.

belt_stone_giant_strength.name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
belt_stone_giant_strength.description: Grants the wearer Strength 20 (stone giant strength). The Geomancer's belt.

shield_crystal.name: Crystal Shield
shield_crystal.description: A shield made of hardened crystal. AC bonus: +2. Reflects light in dazzling patterns.

journal_aeromancer_flight.name: Aeromancer's Flight Journal
journal_aeromancer_flight.description: Pages that flutter constantly as if in a breeze. 'I am becoming air. My body grows light. Soon I will fly forever.'

feather_giant_eagle.name: Giant Eagle Feather
feather_giant_eagle.description: A feather from a giant eagle, as long as a sword. Light as air. Collectors prize these.

rope_cloud_walking.name: Cloud-Walking Rope
rope_cloud_walking.description: A rope that becomes solid when thrown, creating a bridge through the air. 50 feet long.

lightning_rod_charged.name: Charged Lightning Rod
lightning_rod_charged.description: A metal rod crackling with electricity. Can cast Lightning Bolt once before discharging.

storm_gem.name: Storm Gem
storm_gem.description: An opal that contains a miniature thunderstorm. Lightning flickers inside it constantly.

cloak_wind_walker.name: Cloak of the Wind Walker
cloak_wind_walker.description: A cloak that billows constantly. Grants Feather Fall at will. AC bonus: +1.

air_keystone_shard.name: Air Keystone Shard
air_keystone_shard.description: A fragment of the destroyed Air Keystone. It floats if not held down.

bow_wind.name: Wind Bow
bow_wind.description: A bow made of solidified air. Arrows fired from it never miss due to wind. +2 to hit. The Aeromancer's weapon.

arrows_lightning.name: Lightning Arrows (20)
arrows_lightning.description: Arrows that crackle with electricity. Deal +1d6 lightning damage. Quiver of 20.

research_notes_transformation.name: Transformation Research Notes
research_notes_transformation.description: Horrifying notes on the cult's experiments. 'Subject 47: Transformation to fire successful. Subject 48: Transformation to water failed—drowned in own body. Subject 49: Partial earth transformation—subject still screaming but cannot speak.'

vial_elemental_essence.name: Vial of Elemental Essence
vial_elemental_essence.description: A vial containing pure elemental energy. Swirling fire, water, earth, and air. Dangerously unstable.

journal_mad_cultist.name: Mad Cultist's Journal
journal_mad_cultist.description: Increasingly deranged writings. 'The Prince will remake us all. Flesh is weakness. The elements are purity. I welcome the transformation. I WELCOME IT!'

scroll_polymorph.name: Scroll of Polymorph
scroll_polymorph.description: A spell scroll containing the Polymorph spell. One use.

sword_elemental_fury.name: Sword of Elemental Fury
sword_elemental_fury.description: A longsword that shifts between fire, water, earth, and air. +2 weapon. Can change damage type as a free action.

armor_elemental_plate.name: Elemental Plate Armor
armor_elemental_plate.description: Plate mail infused with all four elements. AC 18 (-2). Grants resistance to fire, cold, lightning, and acid.

shield_chaos.name: Shield of Chaos
shield_chaos.description: A shield that shifts appearance constantly. AC bonus: +3. Once per day, can reflect a spell back at its caster.

gloves_elemental_command.name: Gloves of Elemental Command
gloves_elemental_command.description: Gloves that allow the wearer to command one type of elemental (choose fire, water, earth, or air when found). +4 to all checks to command that element type.

crown_elemental_mastery.name: Crown of Elemental Mastery
crown_elemental_mastery.description: A crown that grants the wearer +2 to all saves against elemental effects and the ability to cast Conjure Elemental once per day.

orb_chaos.name: Orb of Chaos
orb_chaos.description: An orb that contains a fragment of the Elemental Chaos. Gazing into it shows impossible realities. Can cast Confusion once per day.

gem_planar_essence.name: Gem of Planar Essence
gem_planar_essence.description: A gem that contains the essence of the Elemental Plane. Invaluable to planar scholars and worth a fortune.

staff_four_winds.name: Staff of the Four Winds
staff_four_winds.description: A staff that can summon wind, rain, lightning, or fog at will. +1 weapon. Usable by wizards and clerics.

herald_crown.name: Herald's Crown
herald_crown.description: The crown worn by the Elemental Herald. Grants immunity to one element type (choose when attuned) and +3 to AC. A powerful artifact.

healing_potion_greater.name: Greater Potion of Healing
healing_potion_greater.description: A superior healing potion. Restores 4d4+4 hit points when consumed.

resistance_charm_poison.name: Charm of Poison Resistance
resistance_charm_poison.description: A protective charm. Grants +4 bonus to saving throws vs poison while worn.

map_temple_layout.name: Temple Layout Map
map_temple_layout.description: A detailed map of the temple complex showing the major chambers and passages. The cultists used this for navigation.

journal_cultist_final_days.name: Cultist's Final Journal
journal_cultist_final_days.description: The last journal of a cultist. 'Tonight is the night. The ritual is prepared. The Serpent Eye will awaken and the world will change forever. I am honored to witness this moment.'

cult_records_complete.name: Complete Cult Records
cult_records_complete.description: Comprehensive records of the cult's operations across Aerthos. Details of kidnappings, ritual sacrifices, and political manipulation spanning decades. The full scope is staggering.

list_cult_members.name: List of Cult Members
list_cult_members.description: A list of all cult members across Aerthos. Names, locations, ranks. Some names are shocking—nobles, merchants, even town officials. The conspiracy ran deep.

evidence_conspiracy.name: Conspiracy Evidence
evidence_conspiracy.description: Damning evidence of the cult's conspiracy. Letters, contracts, and confessions implicating powerful figures. This could shake the foundations of Aerthos society.

scroll_dispel_magic.name: Scroll of Dispel Magic
scroll_dispel_magic.description: A spell scroll containing the Dispel Magic spell. One use. Cancels magical effects and dispels summoned creatures.

book_serpent_prophecy.name: The Serpent Eye - History and Prophecy
book_serpent_prophecy.description: An ancient book detailing the entity's imprisonment millennia ago and prophecies of its return. 'When the ten keys are reunited, the prison shall shatter, and chaos shall reign eternal.'

tome_forbidden_summoning.name: Tome of Forbidden Summoning
tome_forbidden_summoning.description: A dangerous book containing rituals for summoning and binding entities from beyond. The knowledge within should have been destroyed centuries ago.

scroll_protection_evil.name: Scroll of Protection from Evil
scroll_protection_evil.description: A spell scroll containing the Protection from Evil spell. One use. Creates a barrier against evil creatures.

staff_serpent_command.name: Staff of Serpent Command
staff_serpent_command.description: A staff topped with a serpent's head. Grants the ability to command snakes and serpentine creatures. +1 weapon. Usable by wizards and clerics.

vial_vision_water.name: Vial of Vision Water
vial_vision_water.description: Water from the scrying pool. Drinking it grants brief visions of other worlds and realities. May provide insight, or drive one mad.

meditation_cushion_silk.name: Silk Meditation Cushion
meditation_cushion_silk.description: An expensive silk cushion used for meditation. Worth a good sum to the right buyer.

incense_rare.name: Rare Incense
incense_rare.description: Exotic incense from distant lands. The scent is intoxicating and valuable.

serpent_idol_gold.name: Golden Serpent Idol
serpent_idol_gold.description: A solid gold idol of a coiled serpent. Heavy and valuable. The eyes are set with rubies.

offering_bowl_enchanted.name: Enchanted Offering Bowl
offering_bowl_enchanted.description: A ceremonial bowl with protective enchantments. Grants +2 to saving throws vs poison when carried.

prayer_beads_serpent.name: Serpent Prayer Beads
prayer_beads_serpent.description: Prayer beads carved with serpent motifs. Made of jade and onyx. Valuable to collectors.

ritual_dagger_serpent.name: Serpent Ritual Dagger
ritual_dagger_serpent.description: A ceremonial dagger with a serpent-wrapped hilt. Sharp and deadly. +1 weapon. Damage: 1d4+1.

ceremonial_robe.name: Ceremonial Robe
ceremonial_robe.description: A fine robe worn for cult rituals. Provides minimal protection but is valuable. AC bonus: +1.

chalk_ritual.name: Ritual Chalk
chalk_ritual.description: Special chalk for drawing ritual circles and symbols. Infused with powdered silver.

notes_final_ritual.name: Final Ritual Notes
notes_final_ritual.description: Detailed notes for the final ritual. Timing, positions, incantations. 'Midnight tonight. Three hours remain. The Serpent Eye awakens.'

key_pedestal_empty.name: Empty Key Pedestal
key_pedestal_empty.description: One of ten pedestals that once held the keys. Now empty—you carry nine keys, and the tenth is in the inner sanctum.

records_key_recovery.name: Key Recovery Records
records_key_recovery.description: Detailed records of each key's recovery by the cult. Your own adventures are documented here: 'Heroes recovered fourth key—eliminated.' Except you survived.

map_all_locations.name: Map of All Key Locations
map_all_locations.description: A map showing where all ten keys were originally hidden across Aerthos. A historical document of the cult's decades-long quest.

longsword_plus_1.name: Longsword +1
longsword_plus_1.description: Enchanted longsword. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

shield_serpent.name: Shield of the Serpent
shield_serpent.description: A shield emblazoned with the serpent cult symbol. Well-made despite its origin. AC bonus: +1.

chainmail_plus_1.name: Chainmail +1
chainmail_plus_1.description: Enchanted chainmail armor. Provides excellent protection. AC 14 (AC 4 in AD&D). Armor bonus: +1.

arrows_20.name: 20 Arrows
arrows_20.description: A quiver of 20 arrows. Standard ammunition for longbows and shortbows.

training_manual.name: Combat Training Manual
training_manual.description: The cult's training manual for combat drills. Detailed instructions on formations, weapon techniques, and tactics. Explains their discipline.

torture_implements.name: Torture Implements
torture_implements.description: Horrific tools of torture. You choose not to take them, but their presence is evidence of the cult's cruelty.

bloodstained_notes.name: Bloodstained Notes
bloodstained_notes.description: Notes from torture sessions. Names, confessions extracted under duress, broken wills. Grim reading.

prisoner_testimony.name: Prisoner Testimony
prisoner_testimony.description: Testimony from freed prisoners. Accounts of kidnappings, torture, and the cult's plans. Valuable evidence.

serpent_scale_armor.name: Serpent Scale Armor
serpent_scale_armor.description: Armor made from actual serpent scales, enchanted for protection. AC 16 (AC 2 in AD&D). Grants resistance to poison. +2 armor.

greatsword_cursed.name: Cursed Greatsword
greatsword_cursed.description: A powerful greatsword wreathed in dark energy. +2 weapon, but cursed—wielder takes 1 damage per hit delivered. Damage: 2d6+2.

champion_trophy.name: Champion's Trophy
champion_trophy.description: A trophy awarded to the cult champion. Proof of your victory. Gold and jewels.

staff_high_priest.name: High Priest's Staff
staff_high_priest.description: The staff wielded by the cult's high priest. +2 weapon. Grants +1 to spell save DCs. Usable by clerics.

ward_breaker_scroll.name: Ward Breaker Scroll
ward_breaker_scroll.description: A scroll for breaking magical wards and barriers. One use. Dispels wards up to 10th level.

voice_journal.name: The Serpent's Voice - Personal Journal
voice_journal.description: The cult leader's personal journal. Thirty years of obsession. 'I discovered the truth—the Serpent Eye exists, and I will free it. This world deserves chaos. I will be its herald.'

robe_voice.name: Robe of the Serpent's Voice
robe_voice.description: The ceremonial robe of the cult leader. Provides magical protection. AC 15 (AC 3 in AD&D). Grants +2 to all saving throws.

treasure_hoard.name: Treasure Hoard
treasure_hoard.description: A massive collection of gold, gems, jewelry, and art objects. The cult's accumulated wealth. Worth 5000 gold pieces.

tenth_key_shattered.name: The Tenth Key (Shattered)
tenth_key_shattered.description: The shattered remains of the tenth key. You destroyed it in the final battle, ensuring the Serpent Eye can never fully awaken. The prison is sealed forever.

serpent_eye_fragment.name: Fragment of the Serpent Eye
serpent_eye_fragment.description: A small fragment of the entity's power, severed during the battle. It pulses with chaotic energy. Scholars will study this for centuries.

treasure_ultimate.name: Ultimate Treasure Cache
treasure_ultimate.description: The ultimate treasure—everything the cult accumulated for decades. Gold, platinum, gems, artifacts, magic items. Worth 10,000 gold pieces. You saved the world and earned this.

gold_2000.name: 2000 Gold Pieces
gold_2000.description: A large chest containing 2000 gold pieces.

hidden_gold_300.name: Hidden 300 Gold Pieces
hidden_gold_300.description: A hidden cache of 300 gold pieces, discovered among the prisoners' belongings.

leather_armor_plus_1.name: Leather Armor +1
leather_armor_plus_1.description: Enchanted leather armor. See armor.json for full stats. AC 7.

leather_armor_plus_2.name: Leather Armor +2
leather_armor_plus_2.description: Enchanted leather armor. See armor.json for full stats. AC 6.

chain_mail_plus_1.description: Enchanted chain mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 4.

chain_mail_plus_2.description: Enchanted chain mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 3.

chain_mail_plus_3.description: Enchanted chain mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 2.

plate_mail_plus_1.description: Enchanted plate mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 2.

plate_mail_plus_2.description: Enchanted plate mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 1.

plate_mail_plus_3.description: Enchanted plate mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC 0.

plate_mail_plus_4.name: Plate Mail +4
plate_mail_plus_4.description: Enchanted plate mail. See armor.json for full stats. AC -1.

shield_plus_1.description: Enchanted shield. See armor.json for full stats. AC bonus: +2.

shield_plus_2.description: Enchanted shield. See armor.json for full stats. AC bonus: +3.

shield_plus_3.name: Shield +3
shield_plus_3.description: Enchanted shield. See armor.json for full stats. AC bonus: +4.

longsword_plus_2.description: Enchanted longsword. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

longsword_plus_3.description: Enchanted longsword. See weapons.json for full stats. +3 to attack and damage.

short_sword_plus_1.description: Enchanted short sword. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

broad_sword_plus_1.description: Enchanted broad sword. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

bastard_sword_plus_1.description: Enchanted bastard sword. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

two_handed_sword_plus_1.name: Two Handed Sword +1
two_handed_sword_plus_1.description: Enchanted two handed sword. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

dagger_plus_1.description: Enchanted dagger. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

dagger_plus_2.description: Enchanted dagger. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

mace_plus_1.description: Enchanted mace. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

mace_plus_2.description: Enchanted mace. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

battle_axe_plus_1.description: Enchanted battle axe. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

battle_axe_plus_2.name: Battle Axe +2
battle_axe_plus_2.description: Enchanted battle axe. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

hammer_plus_1.name: War Hammer +1
hammer_plus_1.description: Enchanted hammer. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

hammer_plus_2.name: War Hammer +2
hammer_plus_2.description: Enchanted hammer. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

spear_plus_1.name: Spear +1
spear_plus_1.description: Enchanted spear. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack and damage.

spear_plus_2.name: Spear +2
spear_plus_2.description: Enchanted spear. See weapons.json for full stats. +2 to attack and damage.

long_bow_plus_1.name: Long Bow +1
long_bow_plus_1.description: Enchanted longbow. See weapons.json for full stats. +1 to attack rolls.

potion_extra_healing.name: Potion of Extra-Healing
potion_extra_healing.description: A potent red liquid that restores 3d8+3 hit points when consumed. More powerful than a standard healing potion.

potion_giant_strength.name: Potion of Giant Strength
potion_giant_strength.description: A thick, viscous potion that grants the strength of a giant. Type determined randomly: Hill (+7 damage), Stone (+8), Frost (+9), Fire (+10), Cloud (+11), or Storm (+12). Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_speed.name: Potion of Speed
potion_speed.description: A silvery potion that doubles movement and attacks for 5-20 rounds. Side effect: ages the drinker 1 year permanently.

potion_heroism.name: Potion of Heroism
potion_heroism.description: A golden potion that grants temporary levels and HP. 0-level gains 4 levels (4d10 HP), 1st-3rd gain 3 levels (3d10+1 HP), 4th-6th gain 2 levels (2d10+2 HP), 7th-9th gain 1 level (1d10+3 HP). Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_flying.name: Potion of Flying
potion_flying.description: A feather-light potion that grants the ability to fly as per the 3rd level magic-user spell. Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_levitation.name: Potion of Levitation
potion_levitation.description: A light blue potion that allows levitation as per the 2nd level magic-user spell. Max weight: 6,000 gp (600 lbs). Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_climbing.name: Potion of Climbing
potion_climbing.description: A sticky potion that grants superior climbing ability. Base 1% fail chance + 1% per 100gp weight + armor penalties. Duration: 1 turn + 1d4+1 rounds.

potion_invisibility.name: Potion of Invisibility
potion_invisibility.description: A clear, shimmering potion that grants invisibility as per the spell. Breaks when attacking. Duration: 4+1d4 turns (or 3-6 turns if drunk in one gulp).

potion_esp.name: Potion of ESP
potion_esp.description: A purple potion that grants ESP (telepathy) as per the spell. Duration: 5-40 rounds.

potion_clairaudience.name: Potion of Clairaudience
potion_clairaudience.description: A potion that grants the ability to hear unknown areas within 3" (30 yards). Duration: 2 turns.

potion_clairvoyance.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
potion_clairvoyance.description: A crystal-clear potion that grants the ability to see unknown areas up to 3" (30 yards) distant. Duration: 1 turn.

potion_diminution.name: Potion of Diminution
potion_diminution.description: A shrinking potion that reduces the drinker to 5% of normal size. Duration: 6 + 2-5 additional turns.

potion_gaseous_form.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
potion_gaseous_form.description: A smoky potion that transforms the drinker into gaseous form. Movement: 3"/round. Can enter any non-airtight space. Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_animal_control.name: Potion of Animal Control

effect.animals_controlled: 5-20 giant rats, 3-12 man-sized, or 1-4 weighing 1/2 ton+

potion_animal_control.description: A musky potion that allows control over animals. Controls 5-20 small, 3-12 man-sized, or 1-4 large animals. Type determined by d20 roll. Animals with INT 5+ get a save. Duration: 4+1d4 turns.

potion_poison.name: Potion of Poison
potion_poison.description: A deadly poisonous potion disguised as a beneficial one. Effect: Death. Save varies: Weak (+4), Average (normal), or Deadly (-4).

scroll_protection_demons.name: Scroll of Protection from Demons
scroll_protection_demons.description: Creates a 10-foot radius circle that demons cannot enter. Duration: 5-20 rounds. Circle moves with the reader.

scroll_protection_devils.name: Scroll of Protection from Devils
scroll_protection_devils.description: Creates a 10-foot radius circle that devils cannot enter. Duration: 5-20 rounds. Circle moves with the reader.

scroll_protection_lycanthropes.name: Scroll of Protection from Lycanthropes
scroll_protection_lycanthropes.description: Creates a 10-foot radius circle that lycanthropes cannot enter. Affects up to 49 HD of lycanthropes. Duration: 5-30 rounds. Circle moves with the reader.

scroll_protection_magic.name: Scroll of Protection from Magic
scroll_protection_magic.description: Creates a 5-foot radius circle that blocks ALL magic (in and out). Magic items touching the globe must save (50%) or be drained. Duration: 5-30 rounds.

scroll_protection_undead.name: Scroll of Protection from Undead
scroll_protection_undead.description: Creates a 5-foot radius circle that restrains up to 35 HD of undead. Duration: 10-80 rounds. Circle moves with the reader.

ring_feather_falling.name: Ring of Feather Falling
ring_feather_falling.description: A delicate ring that automatically activates when falling 5' or more, causing the wearer to fall slowly and safely.

ring_fire_resistance.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
ring_fire_resistance.description: Grants immunity to normal fires. Very hot fires (lava, hell hound): 10 dmg/round. Exceptionally hot fires (dragon breath, fireball): save at +4, -2 damage per die.

ring_invisibility.name: Ring of Invisibility
ring_invisibility.description: Grants invisibility at will (as spell). Breaks when attacking. 10% are also inaudible.

ring_regeneration.name: Ring of Regeneration
ring_regeneration.description: Restores 1 HP per turn. Will replace lost limbs/organs. Can reverse death (unless poison). 50% chance of vampiric version that regenerates 1/2 damage dealt.

ring_spell_storing.name: Ring of Spell Storing
ring_spell_storing.description: Contains 2-5 (d4+1) spells. Class and level determined randomly. Rechargeable by caster of appropriate level.

ring_water_walking.name: Ring of Water Walking
ring_water_walking.description: Walk on any liquid (mud, snow, quicksand). Max weight 1,200 lbs. Always active.

ring_xray_vision.name: Ring of X-Ray Vision
ring_xray_vision.description: Range 20'. Penetrates 20' wood/cloth, 10' stone, 1" metal (blocked by lead/gold/platinum). Scan 100 sq ft per turn. Max 1 turn before CON drain.

ring_wishes_1d2.name: Ring of Wishes (Multiple)
ring_wishes_1d2.description: Contains 2-8 wishes (2d4). Standard wish spell rules apply.

ring_wishes_3.name: Ring of Three Wishes
ring_wishes_3.description: Contains 3 wishes. 25% chance they are limited wishes instead of full wishes.

ring_contrariness.name: Ring of Contrariness
ring_contrariness.description: Cursed ring. Wearer cannot agree with any idea/statement/action. Cannot be removed.

ring_delusion.name: Ring of Delusion
ring_delusion.description: Cursed ring. Convinces wearer it is a different ring (whatever they desire). Actually does nothing.

ring_weakness.name: Ring of Weakness
ring_weakness.description: Cursed ring. Drains 1 point of STR and CON per turn until reaching 3. Permanent while worn.

wand_enemy_detection.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
wand_enemy_detection.description: Detects enemies in 6" sphere for 1 turn. Charges: 100 - (1d20-1). Cost: 1 charge per use.

wand_fear.name: Wand of Fear
wand_fear.description: Cone 6" long, 2" base. Duration 6 rounds. Save vs Wand. Charges: 100 - (1d20-1). Cost: 1 charge.

wand_magic_detection.name: Wand of Magic Detection
wand_magic_detection.description: Range 3" radius. Duration 1 turn. Charges: 100 - (1d20-1). Cost: 1 charge.

wand_magic_missiles.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
wand_magic_missiles.description: Damage 1d4+1 per missile. Charges: 100 - (1d20-1). Cost: 1 charge per missile.

wand_paralyzation.name: Wand of Paralyzation
wand_paralyzation.description: Ray, range 6". Duration 5-20 rounds. Save vs Wand. Charges: 100 - (1d20-1). Cost: 1 charge.

staff_healing.name: Staff of Healing
staff_healing.description: Restores 3d6+3 HP. Cures blindness/disease/insanity. Usage limit: 1/day per person. Charges: 25 - (1d6-1). Cost: 1 charge.

staff_striking.name: Staff of Striking
staff_striking.description: +3 weapon. Damage 1d6+3. Use 1 charge = standard. 2 charges = double dmg (1d6+6). 3 charges = triple dmg (1d6+9). See weapons.json.

rod_cancellation.name: Rod of Cancellation
rod_cancellation.description: Drains item of ALL magical properties. Touching enemy in combat drains item. Rod becomes brittle/useless after use. Charges: 50 - (1d10-1).

bag_of_holding_250.name: Bag of Holding (250 lbs)
bag_of_holding_250.description: Magical bag holds 250 lbs in 30 cubic ft. Bag weighs 15 lbs. Overloading ruptures bag, contents lost in nilspace.

bag_of_holding_500.name: Bag of Holding (500 lbs)
bag_of_holding_500.description: Magical bag holds 500 lbs in 70 cubic ft. Bag weighs 15 lbs.

bag_of_holding_1000.name: Bag of Holding (1000 lbs)
bag_of_holding_1000.description: Magical bag holds 1,000 lbs in 150 cubic ft. Bag weighs 35 lbs.

bag_of_holding_1500.name: Bag of Holding (1500 lbs)
bag_of_holding_1500.description: Magical bag holds 1,500 lbs in 250 cubic ft. Bag weighs 60 lbs.

boots_elvenkind.name: Boots of Elvenkind
boots_elvenkind.description: 95% chance of silent movement (100% in best conditions).

boots_speed.name: Boots of Speed
boots_speed.description: Base move 24". +2 AC benefit. Requires 1 hour rest for every 1 hour use.

bracers_defense_ac6.name: Bracers of Defense AC 6
bracers_defense_ac6.description: Set AC to 6. Do not stack with armor. See armor.json for armor integration.

bracers_defense_ac4.name: Bracers of Defense AC 4
bracers_defense_ac4.description: Set AC to 4. Do not stack with armor. See armor.json for armor integration.

cloak_displacement.name: Cloak of Displacement
cloak_displacement.description: First attack always misses. Thereafter +2 bonus to AC and saving throws.

cloak_elvenkind.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
cloak_elvenkind.description: Invisibility: 90-100% outdoors/natural settings, 50% in bright light.

gauntlets_ogre_power.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
gauntlets_ogre_power.description: Sets STR to 18/00. +3 to hit, +6 damage. Permanent while worn.

helm_telepathy.name: Helm of Telepathy
helm_telepathy.description: Range 6". Read surface thoughts. Suggestion (save modified by Intelligence).

rope_climbing.name: Rope of Climbing
rope_climbing.description: 60' long. Strong enough to hold 3,000 lbs. Snakes forward/up 10'/round on command.

rope_entanglement.name: Rope of Entanglement
rope_entanglement.description: 20' forward / 10' up. AC -2, HP 22. Entangles up to 8 man-sized creatures. Damage 2-12 per round constriction.

sword_plus_1_vs_magic_users.name: Sword +1, +2 vs Magic-Using Creatures
sword_plus_1_vs_magic_users.description: +1 sword, +2 vs magic-users and monsters which can cast spells. See weapons.json for combat stats.

sword_plus_1_vs_lycanthropes.name: Sword +1, +3 vs Lycanthropes
sword_plus_1_vs_lycanthropes.description: +1 sword, +3 vs lycanthropes and any creature under polymorph/shape change. See weapons.json.

sword_plus_1_vs_regenerating.name: Sword +1, +3 vs Regenerating Creatures
sword_plus_1_vs_regenerating.description: +1 sword, +3 vs creatures that regenerate (trolls, vampires, etc.). See weapons.json.

sword_flame_tongue.name: Sword +1, Flame Tongue
sword_flame_tongue.description: +1 base, +2 vs regenerating, +3 vs cold-using/inflammable/avian, +4 vs undead. Illuminates as torch. Ignites flammables. See weapons.json.

sword_luck_blade.name: Sword +1, Luck Blade
sword_luck_blade.description: +1 sword. Gives +1 to all saving throws. Contains 2-5 wishes (d4+1). See weapons.json.

sword_plus_2_giant_slayer.name: Sword +2, Giant Slayer
sword_plus_2_giant_slayer.description: +2 sword, +3 vs any giant/ettin/ogre mage/titan. Double damage (1d8+1d8+3) vs true giants. See weapons.json.

sword_plus_2_dragon_slayer.name: Sword +2, Dragon Slayer
sword_plus_2_dragon_slayer.description: +2 sword, +4 vs any true dragon. Triple damage (3d8+4) vs specific dragon type (random). See weapons.json.

sword_frost_brand.name: Sword +3, Frost Brand
sword_frost_brand.description: +3 sword, +6 vs fire-using/dwelling creatures. 50% extinguish fires in 10' radius. Protects wielder as Ring of Fire Resistance. See weapons.json.

sword_plus_4.name: Sword +4
sword_plus_4.description: +4 sword. Extremely rare and powerful. See weapons.json.

sword_plus_5.name: Sword +5
sword_plus_5.description: +5 sword. Legendary artifact-level power. See weapons.json.

sword_plus_1_cursed.name: Sword +1, Cursed
sword_plus_1_cursed.description: Cursed sword. Appears as +1 but has penalties. Cannot be unequipped willingly once wielded. See weapons.json.

sword_minus_2_cursed.name: Sword -2, Cursed
sword_minus_2_cursed.description: Cursed sword with -2 penalty to hit and damage. Cannot be unequipped. See weapons.json.

arrows_plus_1.name: Arrows +1 (2d6)
arrows_plus_1.description: 2d6 magic arrows with +1 bonus. Bonuses stack with bow. 50% broken if miss, always destroyed on hit.

arrows_plus_2.name: Arrows +2 (1d6)
arrows_plus_2.description: 1d6 magic arrows with +2 bonus. Bonuses stack with bow. 50% broken if miss, always destroyed on hit.

arrows_plus_3.name: Arrows +3 (1d3)
arrows_plus_3.description: 1d3 magic arrows with +3 bonus. Bonuses stack with bow. 50% broken if miss, always destroyed on hit.

bolts_plus_1.name: Bolts +1 (2d6)
bolts_plus_1.description: 2d6 magic crossbow bolts with +1 bonus. Bonuses stack with crossbow. 50% broken if miss, always destroyed on hit.

bolts_plus_2.name: Bolts +2 (1d6)
bolts_plus_2.description: 1d6 magic crossbow bolts with +2 bonus. Bonuses stack with crossbow. 50% broken if miss, always destroyed on hit.
